sharedConcerns.title: Originating-flow error recovery
sharedConcerns.contract: The flow that caused an error retains ownership; copy states what happened, preserved data, duplicate work or cost risk, next safe action, and optional diagnostics.

sharedConcerns.title: Local-origin and authentication boundary
sharedConcerns.contract: Accept only configured local origins and authenticated local requests where enabled; reject ambiguous forwarded origins and fail closed.

sharedConcerns.title: Filesystem boundary
sharedConcerns.contract: Canonicalize roots, reject traversal and links escaping the root, stage writes, fsync where required, atomically replace, and clean bounded temporary data.

sharedConcerns.title: Subprocess boundary
sharedConcerns.contract: Apply deadlines, cancellation, process-group termination, grace then kill, bounded output, and deterministic temporary-file cleanup.

sharedConcerns.title: Network-egress boundary
sharedConcerns.contract: Require explicit user-triggered egress, validate every redirect, apply deadlines and size limits, redact URLs, and expose cost or data-transfer risk.

sharedConcerns.title: Credentials and secrets boundary
sharedConcerns.contract: Store only secret references or protected values, never return secret material, redact logs and diagnostics, and make deletion explicit and auditable.

sharedConcerns.title: Accessibility interaction contract
sharedConcerns.contract: Provide keyboard pointer touch and command parity, 44px targets, focus entry trap and restoration, live announcements, reflow, contrast, reduced motion, and non-occluding controls.

sharedConcerns.title: Privacy and data minimization
sharedConcerns.contract: Keep source voice and usage data local by default; disclose retention and egress, minimize telemetry, and support explicit cleanup.

sharedConcerns.title: Internationalization and locale contract
sharedConcerns.contract: Preserve source locale, use locale-aware labels and formatting, avoid English-only state logic, and declare speech-language fallback.

sharedConcerns.title: Performance telemetry
sharedConcerns.contract: Measure defined marks without source text or secrets, bind samples to cache and build state, bound cardinality, and keep collection opt-in where exported.

sharedConcerns.title: Operational status presentation
sharedConcerns.contract: Map domain state to one non-duplicated status, identify the owning flow, preserve recovery context, and hide diagnostics on normal surfaces.
